data.title: Islamic Affairs Minister Approves 30 Winners of Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Quran, Sunnah Competition for West Africa
data.content:
Riyadh, November 19, 2026, SPA -- Minister of Islamic Affairs, Dawah and Guidance and General Supervisor of Local and International Quranic Competitions Sheikh Dr. Abdullatif Al Alsheikh has approved the names of 30 winners of the second edition of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques Competition for the Memorization of the Holy Quran and the Prophetic Sunnah for West African countries.
    The competition, organized by the ministry in Nouakchott, Mauritania, brought together 160 contestants from 16 African countries. The winners were announced following the completion of judging and the final tally of results.
    The 30 winners were selected across five categories in each of the competition’s two sections, the Holy Quran and the Sunnah, with three winners in each category. The total prize money exceeded SAR1.14 million, including prizes for winners and incentive awards for participants.
    The competition is part of Saudi Arabia’s ongoing efforts to serve the Holy Quran and Sunnah, support those who memorize them, and encourage their study. It also reflects the leadership’s support for promoting Islamic knowledge, reinforcing the values of moderation and tolerance, and strengthening cooperation with Muslim countries around the world.
    -- SPA
